info.title: Israel Open Data
info.description: Israel Open Data is the national open government data portal of the State of Israel, published at data.gov.il. This connector searches the dataset catalogue, reads dataset, publishing organisation and resource metadata, lists the licences in use, and queries the tabular rows held in the portal DataStore.

get.description: Searches the Israel Open Data catalogue and returns the matching datasets with their full metadata, resources and tags. Use the Search Query option for free text and the Filter Query option to restrict results to a publishing organisation, a file format or another indexed field. Dataset titles and descriptions are published mainly in Hebrew.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The free text to search for across dataset titles, descriptions and tags. Leave this empty to return the whole catalogue. Hebrew text is accepted.

parameters.name: fq
parameters.description: A filter that restricts the results to an indexed field, written as field:value, for example organization:lamas or res_format:CSV. Combine several filters by separating them with a space.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The order the results are returned in, written as a field name followed by asc or desc, for example metadata_modified desc. The portal sorts by relevance and then by most recently modified when this is left empty.

parameters.name: rows
parameters.description: The maximum number of datasets to return in one call. The portal returns 20 datasets when this is left empty and accepts up to 1000.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: The number of datasets to skip before the first returned result, used to page through a large result set.

409.description: The Search Query or Filter Query option could not be parsed by the portal search engine.

500.description: The portal encountered an internal error.

post.description: Searches the Israel Open Data catalogue by sending the search options in a request body rather than in the query string. Use this operation when you want to filter by resource file format, because the Format Filter option is only available here, or when a query or filter value is long enough or contains enough punctuation to be awkward in a query string.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The search options sent to the portal.

409.description: The Search Query or Filter Query option could not be parsed by the portal search engine.

500.description: The portal encountered an internal error.

get.description: Returns the full metadata of a single dataset, including every resource attached to it, its tags, its publishing organisation and its licence. Supply either the dataset name used in the portal address or the dataset identifier.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The identifier of the dataset, or the short name that appears in the portal address, for example water_factory.

404.description: No dataset exists with the supplied identifier or name.

409.description: The Dataset ID or Name option was missing or not valid.

500.description: The portal encountered an internal error.

get.description: Returns the short name of every dataset published on the portal as a plain list of text values. Use one of the returned names with the Get dataset operation to read the full metadata of that dataset.

500.description: The portal encountered an internal error.

get.description: Returns datasets whose name or title begins with the text you supply, as a short suggestion list of names and titles. Use this to look up a dataset name before calling the Get dataset operation. An empty search text returns no suggestions, so always supply at least one character.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The text a dataset name or title must begin with. At least one character is required, because an empty value returns no suggestions.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of suggestions to return.

409.description: A required option was missing or not valid.

500.description: The portal encountered an internal error.

get.description: Returns the short name of every government ministry, authority and municipality that publishes data on the portal, as a plain list of text values. Use one of the returned names with the Get organisation operation to read the full details of that organisation.

500.description: The portal encountered an internal error.

get.description: Returns the details of a single publishing organisation, including its display title, its description and the number of datasets it has published. Organisation titles are published in Hebrew.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The identifier of the organisation, or its short name as returned by the List organisations operation, for example lamas.

404.description: No organisation exists with the supplied identifier or name.

409.description: The Organisation ID or Name option was missing or not valid.

500.description: The portal encountered an internal error.

get.description: Returns publishing organisations whose name or title matches the text you supply, with the short name and the full title of each one. An empty search text returns the first organisations on the portal, so this operation can also be used to list them with their titles.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The text the organisation name or title must match. Leave this empty to return organisations without filtering.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of suggestions to return. The portal returns 20 when this is left empty.

409.description: A required option was missing or not valid.

500.description: The portal encountered an internal error.

get.description: Returns the metadata of a single resource, which is one downloadable file or linked service belonging to a dataset. The metadata includes the download address, the file format, the update frequency and the data quality score the portal has assigned to the resource.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The identifier of the resource, taken from the Resources list of a dataset returned by the Get dataset or Search datasets operation.

404.description: No resource exists with the supplied identifier.

409.description: The Resource ID option was missing or not valid.

500.description: The portal encountered an internal error.

get.description: Searches the resources of the portal by the value of a single resource field, written as field:value. The resource index behind this operation is not currently populated on this portal, so the operation succeeds but returns a count of zero. Use Search datasets and read the Resources list of each dataset instead.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The field and value to match, written as field:value, for example format:CSV. Only stored resource fields such as format, name, description and url can be searched.

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: The name of the resource field the results are ordered by, for example name.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of resources to return in one call.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The number of resources to skip before the first returned result, used to page through a large result set.

200.description: The search completed. The Count property reports how many resources matched.

409.description: The Field Query option named a resource field that cannot be searched.

500.description: The portal encountered an internal error.

get.description: Returns the views configured for one resource. A view is a preview the portal renders for a resource, such as a data table, a chart or a map.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The identifier of the resource whose views are returned.

409.description: A required option was missing or not valid.

500.description: The portal encountered an internal error.

get.description: Returns the individual rows held in the DataStore for one resource, together with the name and data type of every column. Only resources whose DataStore Active property is true can be queried this way. Use the Get dataset operation first to find a resource identifier.

parameters.name: resource_id
parameters.description: The identifier of the resource to read rows from. The resource must have its DataStore Active property set to true.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The free text to search for across every column of the resource. Leave this empty to return rows without filtering.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: An exact match filter supplied as a JSON object of column names and values, for example {"CHOPER":"IZ"}. Use the Search DataStore records (advanced) operation to supply this as a structured object instead of text.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: The names of the columns to return, separated by commas. Every column is returned when this is left empty.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The order the rows are returned in, written as a column name followed by asc or desc, for example _id desc.

parameters.name: distinct
parameters.description: Set this to true to remove duplicate rows from the result.

parameters.name: plain
parameters.description: Set this to false to treat the Search Query option as a full text search expression rather than as plain text.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of rows to return in one call. The portal returns 100 rows when this is left empty.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The number of rows to skip before the first returned row, used to page through a large resource.

parameters.name: include_total
parameters.description: Set this to false to skip counting the total number of matching rows, which makes the call faster on very large resources.

parameters.name: records_format
parameters.description: The shape the rows are returned in. This is fixed to objects so that each row is returned as a named set of column values.

404.description: The resource has no DataStore table, or no resource exists with the supplied identifier.

409.description: The Resource ID option was missing, or a column named in the request does not exist.

500.description: The portal encountered an internal error.

post.description: Returns the individual rows held in the DataStore for one resource, sending the query options in a request body rather than in the query string. Use this operation when you need to filter on exact column values, because the Column Filters option can be supplied here as a structured object.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The DataStore query options sent to the portal.

404.description: The resource has no DataStore table, or no resource exists with the supplied identifier.

409.description: The Resource ID option was missing, or a column named in the request does not exist.

500.description: The portal encountered an internal error.

get.description: Runs a read only SQL query against the DataStore and returns the rows it produces. Name the resource identifier in double quotation marks as the table, for example SELECT * FROM "e83f763b-b7d7-479e-b172-ae981ddc6de5" LIMIT 10. Only resources whose DataStore Active property is true can be queried.

parameters.name: sql
parameters.description: The SQL SELECT statement to run. The resource identifier is used as the table name and must be wrapped in double quotation marks.

200.description: The rows produced by the query were returned.

409.description: A required option was missing or not valid.

500.description: The portal encountered an internal error.

get.description: Returns the short name of every group defined on the portal. The portal categorises its datasets by publishing organisation rather than by group, so only a small number of placeholder groups exist.

409.description: A required option was missing or not valid.

500.description: The portal encountered an internal error.

get.description: Returns every keyword used across the datasets of the portal as a plain list of text values. Most tags are published in Hebrew. Use a returned tag with the Filter Query option of the Search datasets operation.

409.description: A required option was missing or not valid.

500.description: The portal encountered an internal error.

get.description: Returns every licence the portal offers for its datasets, with the identifier that appears in the Licence ID property of a dataset and the address of the full licence text. Some licence titles are published in Hebrew.

500.description: The portal encountered an internal error.

get.description: Returns the file formats used by resources on the portal that match the text you supply, such as csv, xlsx or geojson. An empty search text returns formats without filtering. Use a returned format with the Filter Query option of the Search datasets operation.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The text the file format must contain. Leave this empty to return formats without filtering.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of formats to return. The portal returns five when this is left empty.

409.description: A required option was missing or not valid.

500.description: The portal encountered an internal error.

q.description: The free text to search for across dataset titles, descriptions and tags. Leave this empty to return the whole catalogue. Hebrew text is accepted.

fq.description: A filter that restricts the results to an indexed field, written as field:value, for example organization:lamas or res_format:CSV. Combine several filters by separating them with a space.

fq_list.description: Restricts the results to datasets that have at least one resource in the chosen file format. Pick one or more formats from the list. Each entry is sent to the portal as a res_format filter, and several entries are combined so that a dataset must match every one of them.

sort.description: The order the results are returned in, written as a field name followed by asc or desc, for example metadata_modified desc.

rows.description: The maximum number of datasets to return in one call. The portal returns 20 datasets when this is left empty and accepts up to 1000.

start.description: The number of datasets to skip before the first returned result, used to page through a large result set.

resource_id.description: The identifier of the resource to read rows from. The resource must have its DataStore Active property set to true.

q.description: The free text to search for across every column of the resource.

filters.description: An exact match filter given as a set of column names and the values each column must equal.

fields.description: The names of the columns to return, separated by commas. Every column is returned when this is left empty.

sort.description: The order the rows are returned in, written as a column name followed by asc or desc, for example _id desc.

distinct.description: Set this to true to remove duplicate rows from the result.

plain.description: Set this to false to treat the Search Query option as a full text search expression rather than as plain text.

limit.description: The maximum number of rows to return in one call. The portal returns 100 rows when this is left empty.

offset.description: The number of rows to skip before the first returned row, used to page through a large resource.

include_total.description: Set this to false to skip counting the total number of matching rows, which makes the call faster on very large resources.

records_format.description: The shape the rows are returned in. This is fixed to objects so that each row is returned as a named set of column values, which keeps the response shape the same as the Search DataStore records operation.

DataQualityScore.description: The data quality score the portal has assigned to a resource.

final_score.description: The overall data quality score the portal has calculated for the resource.

metadata.description: The score awarded for the completeness of the metadata of the resource.

updated.description: The score awarded for how recently the resource was updated.

unique_rows.description: The score awarded for the proportion of rows in the resource that are unique.

cells_completeness.description: The score awarded for the proportion of cells in the resource that hold a value.

asci_titles.description: The score awarded for the use of Latin characters in the column titles of the resource.

api_retrievable.description: The score awarded for whether the resource can be read through the DataStore.

score_updated.description: The date and time the data quality score was last calculated.

Resource.description: One downloadable file or linked service belonging to a dataset.

id.description: The identifier of the resource, used by the Get resource and Search DataStore records operations.

package_id.description: The identifier of the dataset the resource belongs to.

name.description: The name of the resource, usually published in Hebrew.

notes.description: Additional notes the publisher has recorded about the resource.

url.description: The web address the resource can be downloaded from.

original_url.description: The web address the resource was originally harvested from.

url_type.description: How the resource is held by the portal, for example upload for a file stored on the portal.

format.description: The file format of the resource, for example CSV or PDF.

mimetype.description: The internet media type of the resource, for example text/csv.

mimetype_inner.description: The internet media type of the file held inside the resource when the resource is an archive.

size.description: The size of the resource in bytes.

hash.description: The checksum of the resource contents, used by the portal to detect changes.

state.description: Whether the resource is active or has been deleted.

position.description: The position of the resource in the resource list of its dataset, counting from zero.

created.description: The date and time the resource was added to the portal.

last_modified.description: The date and time the contents of the resource were last changed.

metadata_modified.description: The date and time the metadata of the resource was last changed.

cache_url.description: The web address of the cached copy of the resource held by the portal.

cache_last_updated.description: The date and time the cached copy of the resource was last refreshed.

datastore_active.description: Whether the rows of the resource can be queried with the Search DataStore records operation.

datastore_contains_all_records_of_source.description: Whether the DataStore holds every row of the source file rather than only part of it.

resource_type.description: The type the publisher has assigned to the resource.

Frequency.description: How often the publisher refreshes the resource, for example Day, Month or Times in day.

how_update.description: Whether the resource is refreshed manually or automatically.

category.description: The category the publisher has assigned to the resource, for example information, description or archive.

ckan_url.description: The address of the portal instance that holds the resource.

resource_ref_number.description: The reference number the publisher has assigned to the resource.

resource_coordinates.description: The geographic coordinates the resource covers, when the resource holds spatial data.

resource_desc_spatial_cover.description: A description of the geographic area the resource covers.

resource_geodetic_ref_sys.description: The geodetic reference system the coordinates of the resource are expressed in.

response_mail.description: The email address enquiries about the resource are sent to.

task_created.description: The date and time the portal last queued a task to load the resource into the DataStore.

ignore_hash.description: Whether the portal reloads the resource even when its checksum has not changed.

set_url_type.description: An internal flag the portal uses while it is loading the resource.

resource_id.description: The identifier the DataStore holds for the resource.

DatasetTag.description: A keyword attached to a dataset.

name.description: The text of the tag, usually published in Hebrew.

display_name.description: The text of the tag as it is shown on the portal.

state.description: Whether the tag is active or has been deleted.

vocabulary_id.description: The identifier of the controlled vocabulary the tag belongs to, when the tag is not a free text tag.

DatasetExtra.description: An additional metadata item recorded against a dataset.

key.description: The name of the additional metadata item.

value.description: The value of the additional metadata item.

DatasetOrganization.description: The organisation that published a dataset, as it is returned inside the dataset.

id.description: The identifier of the publishing organisation.

name.description: The short name of the publishing organisation, for example lamas.

title.description: The full name of the publishing organisation, usually published in Hebrew.

description.description: The description of the publishing organisation.

image_url.description: The web address of the logo of the publishing organisation.

type.description: The type the portal has assigned to the organisation record.

state.description: Whether the publishing organisation is active or has been deleted.

approval_status.description: Whether the publishing organisation has been approved on the portal.

is_organization.description: Whether the record is an organisation rather than a group.

created.description: The date and time the publishing organisation was added to the portal.

Dataset.description: A dataset published on the portal, together with its resources and tags.

name.description: The short name of the dataset, as it appears in the portal address.

title.description: The title of the dataset, usually published in Hebrew.

notes.description: The description of the dataset, usually published in Hebrew.

remark.description: An additional remark the publisher has recorded about the dataset.

url.description: The web address of the original source of the dataset.

url_link.description: The text the portal displays for the source web address of the dataset.

title_link.description: A further web address the publisher has attached to the title of the dataset.

state.description: Whether the dataset is active or has been deleted.

type.description: The type the portal has assigned to the record, normally dataset.

private.description: Whether the dataset is private. Only public datasets are returned by this connector.

isopen.description: Whether the licence of the dataset is recognised as an open licence.

version.description: The version the publisher has recorded for the dataset.

license_id.description: The identifier of the licence of the dataset, matching a licence returned by the List licences operation.

license_title.description: The title of the licence of the dataset.

license_url.description: The web address of the full text of the licence of the dataset.

author.description: The name of the author of the dataset.

author_email.description: The email address of the author of the dataset.

author_notification.description: Whether the author is notified when the dataset changes.

maintainer.description: The name of the person who maintains the dataset.

maintainer_email.description: The email address of the person who maintains the dataset.

mail_box.description: The mailbox the publisher has listed for enquiries about the dataset.

owner_org.description: The identifier of the organisation that published the dataset.

creator_user_id.description: The identifier of the portal account that created the dataset.

metadata_created.description: The date and time the dataset was added to the portal.

metadata_modified.description: The date and time the dataset metadata was last changed.

num_resources.description: The number of resources attached to the dataset.

num_tags.description: The number of tags attached to the dataset.

resources.description: The downloadable files and linked services attached to the dataset.

tags.description: The keywords attached to the dataset.

extras.description: Additional metadata items recorded against the dataset as name and value pairs.

groups.description: The groups the dataset belongs to. The portal categorises datasets by publishing organisation rather than by group, so this is normally empty.

relationships_as_object.description: The relationships in which this dataset is the object.

relationships_as_subject.description: The relationships in which this dataset is the subject.

Organization.description: A government ministry, authority or municipality that publishes data on the portal.

name.description: The short name of the organisation, for example lamas.

title.description: The full name of the organisation, usually published in Hebrew.

display_name.description: The name of the organisation as it is shown on the portal.

notes.description: Additional notes recorded about the organisation.

image_url.description: The web address of the logo of the organisation.

image_display_url.description: The full web address the portal uses to display the logo of the organisation.

type.description: The type the portal has assigned to the organisation record.

state.description: Whether the organisation is active or has been deleted.

approval_status.description: Whether the organisation has been approved on the portal.

is_organization.description: Whether the record is an organisation rather than a group.

organization_id.description: The identifier of the parent organisation, when the organisation sits below another one.

package_count.description: The number of datasets the organisation has published.

num_followers.description: The number of portal accounts that follow the organisation.

created.description: The date and time the organisation was added to the portal.

extras.description: Additional metadata items recorded against the organisation.

tags.description: The keywords attached to the organisation.

groups.description: The groups the organisation belongs to.

users.description: The portal accounts that administer the organisation.

License.description: A licence a dataset can be published under.

id.description: The identifier of the licence, as used by the Licence ID property of a dataset.

title.description: The title of the licence. Some titles are published in Hebrew.

url.description: The web address of the full licence text.

family.description: The licence family the licence belongs to.

maintainer.description: The organisation that maintains the licence.

status.description: Whether the licence is active on the portal.

od_conformance.description: Whether the licence conforms to the Open Definition.

osd_conformance.description: Whether the licence conforms to the Open Source Definition.

is_generic.description: Whether the licence is a generic one rather than a named public licence. The portal returns this as the text True or False rather than as a true or false value.

domain_content.description: Whether the licence is intended for content. The portal returns this as the text True or False rather than as a true or false value.

domain_data.description: Whether the licence is intended for data. The portal returns this as the text True or False rather than as a true or false value.

domain_software.description: Whether the licence is intended for software. The portal returns this as the text True or False rather than as a true or false value.

DatastoreFieldInfo.description: The display settings the publisher has recorded for a DataStore column.

label.description: The label the publisher has given the column.

notes.description: The notes the publisher has recorded about the column.

type_override.description: The data type the publisher has forced for the column, when it differs from the detected type.

DatastoreField.description: One column of a DataStore table.

id.description: The name of the column. The column named _id is the row number the portal assigns.

type.description: The data type of the column, for example text, int, numeric or timestamp.

DatastoreLinks.description: The addresses of the current and next pages of DataStore rows.

start.description: The address of the first page of rows for this query.

next.description: The address of the next page of rows for this query.

prev.description: The address of the previous page of rows for this query.

SearchDatasetsResult.description: The datasets that matched the search, with the total number of matches.

count.description: The total number of datasets that matched the search, which can be larger than the number returned.

sort.description: The sort order the portal applied to the results.

results.description: The datasets that matched the search.

facets.description: The counts of matching datasets grouped by field value. The portal returns this empty unless facets were requested.

search_facets.description: The same facet counts in the extended form the portal search page uses.

SearchDatasetsResponse.description: The response returned by the dataset search operations.

help.description: The web address of the portal documentation for this operation.

success.description: Whether the portal completed the request successfully.

DatasetResponse.description: The response returned by the Get dataset operation.

help.description: The web address of the portal documentation for this operation.

success.description: Whether the portal completed the request successfully.

NameListResponse.description: The response returned by the operations that list names.

help.description: The web address of the portal documentation for this operation.

success.description: Whether the portal completed the request successfully.

result.description: The list of short names returned by the portal.

OrganizationResponse.description: The response returned by the Get organisation operation.

help.description: The web address of the portal documentation for this operation.

success.description: Whether the portal completed the request successfully.

ResourceResponse.description: The response returned by the Get resource operation.

help.description: The web address of the portal documentation for this operation.

success.description: Whether the portal completed the request successfully.

SearchResourcesResult.description: The resources that matched the field query, with the total number of matches.

count.description: The total number of resources that matched the field query.

results.description: The resources that matched the field query. The resource index is not currently populated on this portal, so this is normally empty.

SearchResourcesResponse.description: The response returned by the Search resources operation.

help.description: The web address of the portal documentation for this operation.

success.description: Whether the portal completed the request successfully.

LicenseListResponse.description: The response returned by the List licences operation.

help.description: The web address of the portal documentation for this operation.

success.description: Whether the portal completed the request successfully.

result.description: The licences the portal offers for its datasets.

DatastoreSearchResult.description: The DataStore rows that matched the query, with the definition of every column.

resource_id.description: The identifier of the resource the rows were read from.

total.description: The total number of rows that matched the query, which can be larger than the number returned.

total_was_estimated.description: Whether the total number of rows is an estimate rather than an exact count.

total_estimation_threshold.description: The number of rows above which the portal estimates the total instead of counting it exactly.

include_total.description: Whether the portal counted the total number of matching rows for this query.

limit.description: The maximum number of rows the portal was asked to return.

records_format.description: The shape the rows were returned in, which is always objects for this connector.

fields.description: The name and data type of every column in the resource.

records.description: The rows of the resource. Every resource has its own set of columns, so the properties of each row differ from one resource to another.

DatastoreSearchResponse.description: The response returned by the DataStore search operations.

help.description: The web address of the portal documentation for this operation.

success.description: Whether the portal completed the request successfully.

DatasetSuggestion.description: A dataset suggested for the text supplied to the dataset suggestion search.

name.description: The short name of the dataset, which can be passed to the Get dataset operation.

title.description: The title of the dataset, usually published in Hebrew.

match_field.description: The field the search text matched on, either name or title.

match_displayed.description: The text of the matched field as the portal displays it in a suggestion list.

OrganizationSuggestion.description: A publishing organisation suggested for the text supplied to the organisation suggestion search.

name.description: The short name of the organisation, which can be passed to the Get organisation operation.

title.description: The full name of the organisation, usually published in Hebrew.

ResourceView.description: A preview the portal renders for a resource, such as a data table, a chart or a map.

resource_id.description: The identifier of the resource the view belongs to.

package_id.description: The identifier of the dataset the resource belongs to.

title.description: The title of the view, usually published in Hebrew.

view_type.description: The kind of preview the view renders, for example datatables_view for a data table.

DatastoreSqlField.description: One column produced by a DataStore SQL query.

id.description: The name of the column produced by the query.

type.description: The data type of the column, for example text, int, numeric or timestamp.

DatastoreSqlResult.description: The rows produced by a DataStore SQL query, with the definition of every column.

sql.description: The SQL statement the portal ran.

fields.description: The name and data type of every column produced by the query.

records.description: The rows produced by the query. Every resource has its own set of columns, so the properties of each row differ from one query to another. Rows also carry a _full_text column that the portal uses for searching.

help.description: The web address of the portal documentation for this operation.

success.description: Whether the portal completed the request successfully.

result.description: The organisations that matched the search text.

ResourceViewListResponse.description: The response returned by the List resource views operation.

result.description: The views configured for the resource.
